title: Draft United Kingdom Jurisdiction Profile
scope: AI systems deployed or operated in the United Kingdom, regardless of organizational domicile. The assessed boundary includes supporting infrastructure, services, suppliers, and operational dependencies that support or affect the AI system.

applicability_conditions.question: Can an internet-originated connection reach an AI service, supporting interface, or administrative path within the assessed boundary?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Current network and service inventories, externally observed endpoints, data-flow diagrams, routing and firewall configuration, and an accountable owner's boundary attestation.

applicability_conditions.question: Can an internet-originated connection reach an API that exposes or connects an AI capability, model, data, tool, or administrative function within the assessed boundary?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Current AI API inventory and contracts reconciled to gateway, routing, firewall, endpoint-discovery, and external reachability-test evidence, with an accountable API owner's attestation.

applicability_conditions.question: Does the assessed AI system depend on an external provider for a model, hosted service, platform, tool, data service, or operation?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Supplier and service inventories, architecture and data-flow records, contracts, service descriptions, and the approved shared-responsibility record.

applicability_conditions.question: Is the assessed system an E1 through E4 capability with a material external provider or platform dependency whose replacement or isolation must be addressed for continuity or concentration risk?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Capability baseline and lifecycle records, dependency architecture, provider criticality and concentration analysis, continuity arrangements, and approved exit or isolation criteria.

applicability_conditions.question: Can personnel or services outside the organization administer, configure, deploy, support, or recover any component in the assessed boundary?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Privileged-identity inventories, support agreements, access paths, authorization records, responsibility assignments, and recent access-review evidence.

applicability_conditions.question: Can a model acquired, downloaded, hosted, embedded, trained, fine-tuned, quantized, converted, or modified through an externally sourced or otherwise untrusted path enter approved use in the assessed boundary?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Model inventories and registries, approved-source rules, provider and provenance records, model intake pipeline configuration, integrity verification, and approval records.

applicability_conditions.question: Can externally sourced or otherwise untrusted code, prompts, workflows, configurations, dependencies, tests, deployment artifacts, or AI-generated artifacts enter an internally built or materially configured AI application or pipeline?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Application and pipeline inventories, dependency and build manifests, approved-source rules, repository and release configuration, provenance records, and review or test results.

applicability_conditions.question: Can the assessed AI capability invoke a native tool, function, plugin, connector, action, script, browser, code-execution facility, database, or business-system integration?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Tool and plugin inventories, orchestration and capability configuration, callable-function schemas, authorization policy, execution traces, and accountable owner attestation.

applicability_conditions.question: Can an externally sourced or otherwise untrusted host image, firmware, driver, accelerator component, container, orchestration component, model server, library, storage component, or network dependency enter the AI infrastructure boundary?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Infrastructure and dependency inventories, image and package manifests, approved-source rules, intake pipeline configuration, vulnerability inspection, integrity verification, and acceptance records.

applicability_conditions.question: Does the assessed boundary contain a model, software component, platform, protocol, or infrastructure element that is unsupported, end-of-life, or outside an approved maintenance window?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Version and component inventories reconciled to provider support notices, maintenance records, approved lifecycle standards, exception records, and replacement plans.

applicability_conditions.question: Does the assessed boundary contain a model that is end-of-life, replaced, unsupported, compromised, nonconforming, expired, or abandoned?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Model registry and deployment records reconciled to provider notices, validation and incident records, approved lifecycle decisions, access state, and model retirement plans.

applicability_conditions.question: Does the AI infrastructure boundary contain an unsupported or end-of-life host, firmware, driver, accelerator, container, orchestration component, model server, library, storage component, network component, or managed-service dependency?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Infrastructure and dependency inventories reconciled to provider support notices, vulnerability records, managed-service responsibility records, approved exceptions, and remediation plans.

applicability_conditions.question: Has the accountable authority determined that an experiment, pilot, production service, embedded AI capability, or third-party AI service in the assessed boundary must be retired or decommissioned?
applicability_conditions.resolution_evidence: Approved lifecycle or portfolio decision, accountable owner and authority, affected capability and dependency inventory, target decommissioning state, continuity assessment, and retirement plan.

source_boundary.statement: Profile content is original ESAF synthesis bounded to the ESAF library and pinned lifecycle metadata only from the three exact Draft mapping registry records. Relationships, external outcomes, and evidence are not imported. Substantive mapping content and mapping interpretations are also excluded.
excluded_sources: United Kingdom laws, regulations, sector rules, and regulatory guidance
External assurance outcomes or certification decisions
Substantive content, relationships, external outcomes, evidence, and interpretations from the three pinned Draft mapping records
All content and interpretations from other or unpinned external mappings
